headlines.snippet: It has been cleared for publication that Sergeant Major Ron Jonathan Reitman and Sergeant Yuval Shai Suilam fell in a terrorist attack at the Efrat junction. Reitman, 23 from Ashkelon, and Suilam, 20 from Hod Hasharon, served in the Ari Battalion of the Rescue Brigade. Three additional combatants were moderately and lightly injured. The IDF estimates that the terrorists planned a larger attack against civilians, which was thwarted due to the combatants' actions. The two terrorists were eliminated, and a foreign photographer is suspected of knowing about the attack in advance. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and preparations for a full closure in the West Bank.
